scope: Complete recorded empty normal-10pt PDF document surfaces: eighteen native sources and twenty-seven complete-surface samples per locale, including dirty/floating view-status width changes. Captions/external ViewStatus pixels, the general thumb-length rule and full forms remain open.

nativeInputs.scope: Eighteen measured normal-10pt empty PDF surfaces on native ru/en: recorded size axes, ReadOnly/Enabled, border, native-removed properties and ViewStatus width coupling. Titles and external ViewStatus pixels are outside this surface region; unmeasured sizes/fonts/profiles and full forms remain open.

nativeMetricsChangedAfterFreeze: Explanatory scope/acceptance metadata only; all XML, rows, dimensions and RGB hashes are unchanged.

implementation.dimensions: The existing normal document width/height rules apply. A visible ViewStatusAddition imposes a measured 300px minimum; hidden status gives 200px at Width20. Width15/20/30 with status gives 300px, Width31 gives 310px; Height2/3/4 gives 43/68/93px.
implementation.paint: One shared PDF surface function draws the page edge and solid scrollbar spans, with 576 opaque grayscale fragment pixels for caps/arrows. All 3103860 native source pixels are independently reproduced. No whole-widget image is stored in runtime.
implementation.scopeGate: Native paint requires Linux, normal calibrated font metrics, DPR1, zoom100 and the recorded width/height axes. Other axes/profiles use the existing approximate surface and a localized incomplete-matching notice. The general native thumb-length formula remains unverified.
implementation.state: ReadOnly retains active outer border and scrollbars; Enabled=false lightens outer border, thumbs and end arrows. Start arrows remain unavailable. The page edge remains black.
implementation.ignoredProperties: Native field export removes BackColor/ShowToolbar. Requested XML and canonical exports are retained; the PDF toolbar prototype is no longer rendered.
implementation.viewStatusScope: The addition controls width and is toggled live, including 300px to 200px in the detached window. Its external chip/text pixels and the field title are not part of this surface comparison.

remaining: The general native thumb-length formula and unrecorded size axes, fonts, stretch/fraction/bound combinations, DPI and zoom profiles.
External ViewStatus/title pixels, other PDF properties/content, typed applicability/computed inspector semantics, other surfaces and full forms; full Linux and Windows acceptance remain open.
